meta.name: aed:uptime
meta.description: Provider token, formatted '<provider>:<identifier>'. Supported: 'instatus:subdomain', 'statuspage:page-id', 'custom:https://your-api-endpoint'. The custom endpoint must return JSON: { status: 'operational'|'degraded'|'outage'|'maintenance', label?, pageUrl? }. Results cached for 60s in sessionStorage.

data.description: Per-element status pill. If the element is an <a>, it links to the provider status page. 'unknown' status hides the element.

data-aed-variant.description: Strip background/border for inline placement (e.g. inside a footer copyright line).
